text:
sarah.k: Quick heads-up — planning a tf apply for tenant VPC cutover in ~40m. This is the tenant-vpc subnet split + natgw attach + service-account IAM bind. I pushed the plan to the PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/tenant-vpc/1234

sarah.k: please ack if you need us to move the window. We’re doing a staged canary: 10% tenant traffic -> 100% over 15m if no errors.

devin: acked. I’ll watch routing tests and e2e for svc-bus. Do we have a rollback plan spelled out?

mike_infra: yes — rollback is basically `terraform apply` of the previous tag (v2026-03-01-rollback) which reattaches old route tables and deletes the extra NAT. I added a manual step for re-registering the peering if needed.

elaine: tagging @oncall-amber for quorum on IAM binds. IAM changes touch cross-account role assumptions. Amber, preference to abort if any 403s seen?

oncall-amber: here — I’d prefer hold on full rollout if >3% 403s or any unexpected 5xx from control-plane calls. Also watch `sts:AssumeRole` latencies.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued apply: infra/tenant-vpc PR #1234 — scheduled for 40 minutes from root message. Canary policy: 10/30/60/100. Auto-rollback thresholds: 403_rate>3% | route-failure>2%.

devin: received. I'll run the smoke curl checks against canary subnets once canary flips. Example check: `for ip in $(cat canary_ips); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://$ip/health || echo failure:$ip; done`

mike_infra: preflight done: `terraform plan` output snippet: 
```
# aws_route.gateway will be changed in-place
+ aws_nat_gateway.canary (new)
- aws_nat_gateway.old_nat (tainted)
+ aws_iam_role_binding.tenant_svc: will add 1 binding
```
No drift detected for peering.

elaine: confirm KMS key policy change? Are we rotating keys as part of this?

mike_infra: not rotating KMS in this change. We're adding IAM binding for `svc-bus@tenant` to allow assume-role only. Key policy unchanged.

sarah.k: timeline: apply starts at T+40, canary flip T+55, monitor 20m, then ramp. Post-apply we’ll run the release notes publish step and tag the infra repo.

devin: if the canary fails, what's the runbook?

mike_infra: runbook (short):
1) `deploy-bot abort` -> stops further rollouts and triggers rollback job.
2) Run `terraform apply -var-file=rollback-vars.tfvars -target=module.tenant_vpc` with tag v2026-03-01-rollback.
3) Revert BGP session if peering flaps: `ssh net-admin@jump` -> `sudo bgpctl reset neighbor x.x.x.x`
4) Open incident ticket with `#incidents` and notify product owners.

elaine: noted. I'll be on standby for IAM approve flows and to verify `sts:AssumeRole` metrics in CloudWatch.

oncall-amber: can we add a temporary metric alert for the window? If we see `AssumeRoleErrors > 1` in 5m, page me.

mike_infra: created temporary CloudWatch alarm: `Tenant/AssumeRoleErrors-ephemeral` threshold 1 in 5m, action -> pager.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting canary apply now (operator: mike_infra). Logs: https://deploylogs/tenant-vpc/1769995555/canary

sarah.k: watching. will post progress in this thread. :eyes:

devin: canary smoke results: all 200s, avg latency 72ms, no 403s so far.

mike_infra: canary succeeded at T+20. Rolling to 30% now.

devin: 30% looks good. One tenant reported a transient 502 at T+22, but it recovered. No 403.

elaine: IAM audit log shows the new `AssumeRole` entries with expected principal. No denied events.

oncall-amber: alarm fired once but it was from a test account, cleared automatically. Not paging.

mike_infra: moving to 60% in 10m. Full apply scheduled at T+50 if no escalation.

sarah.k: reminder to update release notes after full ramp: include PR link, rollback tag, and contact matrix.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] full rollout complete. Tagging repo: `tenant-vpc@v2026-03-15-cutover`

devin: post-roll smoke: all checks pass. I’ll run an extended 1h runbook for routing consistency.

elaine: publishing release note draft to internal release: "Tenant VPC cutover: subnet split, NAT consolidation, tenant svc-bus role bind. Rollback tag: v2026-03-01-rollback. Oncall: Amber. Infra owner: mike_infra."

sarah.k: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until the post-roll monitoring window closes (T+80). If anything weird, call the rollback.

mike_infra: marking the PR as merged and archived. Will follow up with the detailed postmortem doc if we see drift in next 24h.

oncall-amber: ACK.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] note: automated rollback job remains on standby until T+80.

sarah.k: closing window at T+80 — all quiet. Great job team. :tada:
